references.text: The context for Joshua receiving his inheritance after the entire land had been distributed among the tribes
Timnath-Serah is mentioned as the place where Joshua was buried in the hill country of Ephraim
Timnath-Heres (the same place as Timnath-Serah) is mentioned as Joshua's burial site
The principle of asking for and receiving an inheritance according to the Lord's command, just as Joshua asked for the city
Joshua son of Nun is mentioned as the leader of the land distribution
A parallel to Caleb, who also asked for and received his inheritance according to the Lord's command
The tribe of Ephraim and their hill country where Timnath-Serah was located
